newsitem.title: USA: Global TeleMedia to buy Intl TeleData.
newsitem.headline: Global TeleMedia to buy Intl TeleData.

text.p: Global TeleMedia International Inc said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire 75 percent of the shares of privately-held International TeleData Corp for an undisclosed combination of cash, notes and stock.
The company said it expects to tender for the remaining shares on the same terms and conditions after obtaining required regulatory approval.
The acquisition is expected to close during the third quarter, subject to the completion of due diligence by both parties, the formalization of terms and the signing of a definitive agreement.

International TeleData, with about $15 million in annual revenues, sells telecommunications products and services. Global TeleMedia provides turnkey products to carriers, wholesalers, resellers and independent marketing agents to telecommunications companies.
